description: Approved predefined questions and answers for the Birthday Book chatbot.
notes: This file contains approved Q&A content, not birthday records.
For app-help questions, prefer the approved answer when a question matches.
For birthday messages, gift suggestions, and planning, use the approved answer as a conversational starter and then generate a helpful response with the configured AI provider.
Do not claim to read, create, edit, or delete birthday records unless the chatbot is connected to the app data and the operation succeeds.
Do not claim background notifications or cross-device sync are available in the current standalone app.
fallback_answer: I don't have enough information to answer that confidently. I can explain the app's supported features or help you rephrase your question.

items.question: How do I add a birthday?
items.answer: Select Add birthday, enter the person's name and birthday, add any optional details, choose your planning reminders, and select Save birthday.

items.question: How do I edit or delete a birthday?
items.answer: Find the person in your birthday list. Select Edit to update their details, or Delete to remove their birthday after confirming.

items.question: How do I see upcoming birthdays?
items.answer: The Upcoming birthdays section lists saved birthdays in date order and shows how many days remain until each birthday.

items.question: Can I add notes or gift ideas?
items.answer: Yes. Open a birthday record and use the Notes or gift ideas field to save helpful details for later.

items.question: Can I search for someone?
items.answer: Use the search field to find people by name or matching relationship and notes, or use the relationship filter to narrow the list.

items.question: Will I receive a notification if the app is closed?
items.answer: The current standalone app shows reminders while you use it. It does not send background notifications while closed.

items.question: How do I back up my birthdays?
items.answer: Select Backup to download a JSON backup file. Keep it somewhere secure so you can restore your saved birthdays later.

items.question: How do I restore a backup?
items.answer: Select Import, choose a Birthday Book backup file, review the records, and choose whether to merge them or replace existing records.

items.question: Where is my birthday data stored?
items.answer: The current version stores records in your browser's local storage. Data persistence can vary when the HTML file is opened directly, so export backups regularly.

items.question: Can I use the app on another device?
items.answer: You can transfer a backup to another device and import it. The current version does not automatically synchronise records between devices.

items.question: Help me write a birthday message.
items.answer: Of course! Tell me who the message is for, your relationship with them, and whether you want it to sound heartfelt, funny, casual, or professional.

items.question: Can you suggest a birthday gift?
items.answer: Yes. Tell me the person's interests, your relationship, and your approximate budget. I'll suggest thoughtful options based on those details.

items.question: Help me plan a birthday.
items.answer: I can help you create a simple plan. Tell me the birthday date, the person's interests, your budget, and whether you prefer a celebration at home or outside.

items.question: What should I do a week before a birthday?
items.answer: Confirm your plans, shortlist gifts, arrange any reservations or deliveries, and draft a birthday message. Adjust the checklist to suit the person and occasion.

items.question: Can you remember a person's birthday for me?
items.answer: You can save the birthday in Birthday Book. The current app can display upcoming dates, but the chatbot should not claim it has saved a record unless it is connected to the app's data and confirms the save.

items.question: Can you show me all my saved birthdays?
items.answer: I can explain how to view your birthday list. To retrieve actual saved records, the chatbot must be securely connected to your app's data.

items.question: What if you don't know the answer?
items.answer: I don't have enough information to answer that confidently. I can explain the app's supported features or help you rephrase your question.
